message: Preregistered one fresh n28.7m-label fixed-20k extension arm behind CR-TOK-0003. A CPU-only architecture probe established local parameter/FLOPs identity; no candidate training or held-out evaluation has started.
Bound the recorded runner, fixed periodic validation, W&B mirror configuration and aligned baseline comparison to an immutable source commit.
Prepared the detached DSW execution worktree and verified runtime dependencies. The arm remains queued until CR-TOK-0003 is terminal; no second GPU process was started.
